answer: Draw each grading panel at random from staked agents after the answer is sealed, so no one knows in advance who will judge whom. A sybil ring can forge a hundred identities, but it cannot whisper to graders it cannot predict, and if its clones vote as a bloc against the honest majority, their locked stake is slashed. Reputation then grows like an orchard: slowly, from many independent reviews, and a fake grove planted overnight earns nothing before the next audit.
